headline: Fabtech Technologies submits investor presentation to NSE
summary: Fabtech Technologies Limited has officially submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchange. The filing provides insights into the company's current business updates, strategy, or financial standing. Such presentations help retail and institutional shareholders understand operational progress. Investors in the company can review the document for details on recent developments.

headline: Fabtech Technologies appoints Alan Dias as Senior Management Personnel
summary: Fabtech Technologies Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Alan Dias as a Senior Management Personnel effective October 28, 2026. This is a routine internal management update filed with the exchange. Such corporate governance appointments have a minimal immediate impact on the company's financial results. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap corporate developments will find this procedural filing of limited trading relevance.
why_it_matters: Routine management appointment with no immediate financial impact
